title: Sunflower sea star population, before vs. after the 2013 wasting-disease outbreak

source.name: Sea Star Wasting Disease monitoring
source.publisher: NOAA Fisheries / MARINe (UC Santa Cruz coastal monitoring network)

notes: A wasting-disease outbreak that swept the Pacific coast starting in 2013 killed an estimated 6 billion sunflower sea stars -- up to 99% of the population from Washington to Mexico, with the species completely disappearing off the California and Oregon coasts by 2015. Shown as percent of the pre-outbreak population remaining.
